criteria.why: Outer vertical Flex (justify center => max, align center) centers the inner maxWidth 320 column, whose stretch alignment makes it exactly 320 wide when the outer View gets the screen's constraints.
keyboardType="emailAddress" is not a valid value (the API uses "email"), so the email keyboard is not applied; heading, obscured password and the Text labels above the fields are fine.

runtime.why: Root View has grow={1}, which wraps it in Flexible: incorrect ParentDataWidget use unless the parent is a flex; in a loose flex parent it also shrink-wraps its width, so horizontal centering depends on the parent.

4-login-1.tsx.notes: Uses direction "column"/"row" (not valid; both fall back to vertical, which happens to still lay out correctly, including the button) and keyboardType "emailAddress" instead of "email".
